100.0: Photographer Phil Sheldon watches the age of marvels unfold from street level, from the first heroes through Galactus and Gwen Stacy's death, then keeps shooting into the 1970s while dying of cancer as he races to finish one last book.
100.3: At the end of time, Galactus walks Franklin Richards through the history of the Marvel Universe, picking up where the early eras leave off.
100.4: Robert Reynolds remembers he was the Sentry, a hero the world forgot, and reunites with allies like the Fantastic Four and the Hulk before erasing everyone's memory again, his own included, to stop his dark side, the Void.

101.0: A teenager leaves Matt a baby who may be the messiah or the Antichrist, and Mysterio's scheme to break him ends with Bullseye killing Karen Page.
101.1: Natasha Romanoff squares off with Yelena Belova, a younger Red Room graduate who wants the Black Widow name for herself.
101.2: Natasha runs a long con on Yelena Belova that leaves the two Widows wearing each other's faces.
101.3: The Kingpin convinces Maya Lopez, a deaf woman who can copy any movement she sees, that Daredevil killed her father, and she comes after Matt as Echo.
101.4: Frank comes back to New York and takes apart the Gnucci crime family, with copycat vigilantes, his oddball neighbors and the Russian caught up in the war.
101.5: Noh-Varr, a Kree soldier stranded on Earth after Dr. Midas shoots down his ship, declares war on humanity.
101.7: Storm's team hunts for Destiny's prophetic diaries, and Vargas kills Psylocke to keep his own fate secret.
101.8: Cassandra Nova sends giant Sentinels to destroy Genosha, killing 16 million mutants, and Xavier tells the world he is a mutant.
101.9: Ben Urich digs into the story of a traumatized boy who saw Daredevil fight his father, the low-rent villain Leap-Frog.
101.10: Matt writes letters to the late Karen Page about his first days as Daredevil, in the yellow costume, and how they fell for each other.
101.11: Norman Osborn kidnaps Peter and tortures him for days, trying to remake him as his heir.
101.12: Ezekiel tells Peter his powers might be mystical, and the energy vampire Morlun arrives to feed on him.
101.13: In London, the X-Men find Chamber dating pop star Sugar Kane while a killer named Mr. Clean preys on the mutants living underground.
101.14: The Timebroker pulls Blink and a squad of mutants from broken realities and sends them to fix other worlds if they ever want to go home.
101.15: In 19th-century Canada, sickly James Howlett pops his claws after his father's murder and flees with Rose, taking the name Logan.
101.16: Rogue's nightmares lead the team to escort a band of dinosaur people to the Savage Land, where Brainchild is waiting.
101.19: John Sublime's U-Men harvest mutant organs, and the X-Men learn Cassandra Nova is hiding inside Xavier's body.
101.20: The Russian comes back, rebuilt with stolen S.H.I.E.L.D. technology, as Frank fights his way through a private army.
101.21: In Australia, the team protects Viceroy's mutant children, clears Gambit of murder and exposes Lady Mastermind and Sebastian Shaw.
101.23: Cassandra Nova, wearing Xavier's body, turns the Shi'ar Imperial Guard against Earth until the X-Men bring Xavier back.
101.26: Banner is blamed for a child's televised murder and goes on the run from a conspiracy, helped only by the mysterious Mr. Blue.
101.29: The Kingpin is overthrown, and the upstart who takes his place sells Matt's secret identity to the FBI.
101.30: Aunt May finds out Peter is Spider-Man, and the two finally talk it all through.
101.31: Banshee's X-Corps mutant police force falls apart in Paris when Mystique and her people turn on it.
101.32: In Madripoor, Shaitan steals Storm's ruby to open a door for Khan's invading army, and the X-Men barely turn it back.
101.34: Banner gets caught in a small-town standoff with a gunman while federal agents close in on him.
101.35: A tabloid outs Matt as Daredevil, and he denies it publicly while the FBI and every criminal in town push him.
101.41: Fantomex arrives with a Weapon Plus secret, and Scott's marriage starts to crack as he grows close to Emma Frost.
101.46: The recovering X-Treme team gets dinner with old teammates and feels the growing split with Xavier.
101.47: The team fights to keep a mutant documentary on the air over Archangel's objections.
101.48: A young mutant killer seeks asylum at the mansion, Emma Frost blocks the team under Elias Bogan's control and Storm's X-Men split from Xavier's.
101.49: After a terrorist attack on a small American town, Captain America goes after the people responsible.
101.50: In 1942, the Army tests the super-soldier serum on Black soldiers, and Isaiah Bradley is the one who survives it.
101.51: A pack of werewolf-like mutants led by Maximus Lobo comes after Wolverine.
101.53: Quentin Quire and his Omega Gang, high on the drug Kick, riot at the school, and Sophie of the Stepford Cuckoos dies.
101.54: Nadia Blonsky gets close to Banner and hands him to Home Base, which frees her husband, the Abomination, for a rematch.
101.56: Matt meets Milla Donovan, a blind woman whose life gets tangled up with his.
101.58: On Valentine's Day, Peter records a message to Gwen Stacy remembering how they fell in love.
101.59: The X-Men face the Church of Humanity, a zealot group crucifying mutants and plotting against the Catholic Church.
101.60: Doom trades his first love to demons for magic, takes baby Valeria and drags Franklin to hell, forcing Reed to learn sorcery to beat him.
101.61: The Red Skull unleashes a deadly red gas from Mount Rushmore, and the Avengers race to contain it.
101.63: William Stryker returns with a new crusade against mutants, and the X-Treme team has to stop him a second time.
101.65: The Kingpin comes back to reclaim Hell's Kitchen, and Daredevil beats him in public and names himself the neighborhood's new Kingpin.
101.66: The Absorbing Man learns he can take over minds and uses that to get at Banner and the Hulk.
101.72: Dani Moonstar teaches a new class of New Mutants at the Xavier Institute.
101.73: Six teenagers learn their parents are the Pride, a secret supervillain cabal that runs Los Angeles, and run away from home.
101.74: With Doom gone, the Fantastic Four take control of Latveria, and the world assumes the worst about Reed's motives.
101.75: The Thing dies, and the rest of the Fantastic Four go to heaven to bring him back.
101.76: Peter helps Doctor Strange stop Dormammu and gets flung through every moment of his own life.
101.78: Banner reconnects with Doc Samson as Home Base closes in, and Mr. Blue is revealed to be Betty Ross.
101.79: Nightcrawler learns his father is the mutant Azazel.
101.81: Tony Stark becomes U.S. secretary of defense.
101.82: Maya Lopez comes back to check on Matt and goes on a vision quest of her own.
101.83: Wolverine hunts the smugglers who left a truckload of migrants to die crossing the border.
101.86: Wolverine, Cyclops and Fantomex raid the Weapon Plus program and learn how far back it really goes.
101.87: As the X-Treme Sanctions Executive, the team confronts mutants who seized a California town and are driving out its human residents.
101.88: The Runaways keep running, face a teenage vampire named Topher and cross paths with Cloak and Dagger.
101.89: Ezekiel's real plan for Peter comes out, and he ends up giving his own life in Peter's place.
101.90: Storm exposes a mutant slave trade feeding a gladiator arena in Japan.
101.91: Xorn reveals himself as Magneto and conquers New York, and Jean Grey dies before Wolverine ends it.
101.57: Peter and Mary Jane work through their reconciliation while one of Peter's students searches for her missing brother, a kid Spider-Man himself handed to the police.
101.62: She-Hulk loses control of her transformations and goes berserk in Idaho, and Jack of Hearts dies saving Ant-Man's daughter in the arc's final chapter.
101.64: Frank helps social worker Jen Cooke after she uncovers a dark secret hidden beneath the city's streets.
101.67: Frank heads to a small Texas town to take down militia gunrunners and teams up with the new sheriff, who just lost his boyfriend to them.
101.68: Unable to get work as an assassin, Elektra starts coming apart and hunts for whoever set out to wreck her career.
101.69: Wolverine hunts the people who murdered a young neighbor in her sleep and follows the trail to a cult holding women captive in a desert fortress.
101.70: Elektra tries to build a new life around new ideals until the Hand comes calling to drag her back into its fold.
101.71: The Timebroker sends the Exiles into the main Marvel Universe to stop a possessed Havok from killing two mutant boys, and Nocturne gets four days with her father.
101.6: Warp Savant marks his 18th birthday by restaging Magneto's attack on Cape Citadel, but after Phoenix and Wolverine escape the hellish place he sent them, the young mutant turns his power on himself.
101.17: Cyclops talks Xorn out of collapsing into a black hole inside a Chinese prison and recruits him, then Cassandra Nova, hiding in Xavier's body, makes Beak beat Beast and leaves Earth with the Shi'ar.
101.22: A trip into the Dreamtime with Gateway leaves Rogue holding a new volume of Destiny's diaries, and she shakes off the Shadow King's attempt to poison her memories of Destiny.
101.24: After Archangel pulls Stacy X out of a Church of Humanity massacre at a mutant brothel, the new team traces a drug that grants temporary mutations to the Vanisher, who slips away.
101.27: The Exiles save Alpha Flight from a rampaging Hulk, then help the heroes of a Skrull-ruled Earth drive off Galactus in a fight that leaves Thunderbird comatose and brings in Sasquatch.
101.28: Frank Castle hunts down Joe Perrett, the Vietnam buddy who once saved his life, after Joe snaps and kills his family, then shoots him and catches his body as it falls.
101.33: Spider-Man defeats the Shade on the astral plane but misses Mary Jane's New York visit, then flies to Los Angeles with Aunt May and beats a con man wielding copies of Doctor Octopus' arms.
101.36: The Exiles and Weapon X fight over whether young David Richards must die on a Sentinel-ruled Earth until Sabretooth stays behind to raise him, and later missions pit the team against Namor and Mojo.
101.37: Norman Osborn smears Spider-Man with doctored footage of Gwen Stacy's death and leaves Flash Thompson brain-damaged in a staged truck crash, but Peter beats him and refuses to kill him.
101.38: Police kill Sonny, a frightened boy still changing in Mutant Town, despite Xorn's efforts to save him, and in Paris Fantomex demands sanctuary from Xavier as Jean feels the Phoenix stir.
101.39: Stacy X eases a dying mutant's pain while the X-Men trace deadly designer genes to the Vanisher, whom Archangel beats by quietly outbidding him for his own crew.
101.40: Bruce Banner teams with the unkillable Sandra Verdugo to escape Home Base agent Pratt, and after Pratt kills a robot posing as her son, Banner finally becomes the Hulk and tears him apart.
101.42: Stacy X and Iceman break a treelike Black Tom's hold on the X-Men, and Juggernaut, pulled from the sea by young Sammy Pare, finds a home at the school before Northstar signs on to teach.
101.43: Reed outwits Modulus, a living equation born from his tampered PDA, while Johnny's turn as the team's finance chief ends with Sue containing a molecular chain reaction that threatens New York.
101.44: Frank frees mob boss Tommy Casino from Colombian guerrillas only to use him as bait to slaughter the East Coast mob, then fights Wolverine before the two take down Tommy's vengeful brother Tony.
101.45: Shathra, a spider-wasp totem, smears Spider-Man in the press until he beats her in an African temple, and Peter and Mary Jane reunite after a storm strands them at the same airport.
101.52: After the Exiles cure a techno-organic Legacy Virus, Magik replaces the homeward-bound Blink, while Weapon X serves a tyrannical Tony Stark until Black Bolt's scream and Sue Storm's knife end his reign.
101.55: Frank shadows two crooked NYPD detectives, a gambler deep in mob debt and his wife-beating partner, but holds his fire as both men die in a bloody clash over the debt.
101.77: The Venom symbiote abandons a cancer-stricken Eddie Brock to feed on adrenaline and chase Spider-Man, but Peter forces it back onto the dying Eddie, keeping him alive and bound to the alien.
101.80: A dying vampire Union Jack's spell scatters the Exiles across realities, and Mimic comes back carrying a Brood embryo that takes him over and kills Sunfire before Blink rejoins the team.
101.84: Disowned by his parents, Josh Foley kisses a powerless Wolfsbane back into her wild wolf form, which nearly kills him until he heals himself and his skin turns gold.
101.85: Husk brings Archangel home to Kentucky, where a Cabot family assault kills her mother's partner and Julia Cabot drowns herself holding her dead lover Jay Guthrie, who then comes back to life.

102.0: With Queen Elizabeth murdered and King James hunting the witchbreed, Sir Nicholas Fury learns that Rojhaz is a time-lost Steve Rogers and carries him back through a rift to save the collapsing universe.
102.1: Teenage Emma Frost discovers her telepathy in a cruel Boston family, then rejects her father Winston's fortune and leaves home after he commits her brother Christian to a mental hospital.
102.2: Daredevil recruits Spider-Man and Wolverine to take down the Punisher, who outwits the heroes at every turn and finally turns an amnesiac Bruce Banner loose on them as the Hulk.
102.3: Time-freezing runaway Kiden Nixon forms a street crew of young mutants with her former teacher Cameron Palmer and later saves Cameron from a deadly fall instead of avenging her father on pimp Zebra Daddy.
102.4: Grieving Bruce Banner tells Doc Samson how the newborn gray Hulk kidnapped Betty Ross and finally spared her father, General Ross, then turns into the Hulk again when Samson challenges his self-blame.
102.5: A year after claiming Hell's Kitchen, Daredevil crushes a Yakuza takeover with help from fellow heroes, but Ben Urich ties his spiral to Karen Page's death and his secret wife Milla Donovan leaves him.
102.6: Hyperion takes over Weapon X and dooms a mutant Earth before the Timebroker forces both teams into a death match, where Hyperion kills the traitorous Magik and Gambit impales him with her Soulsword.
102.7: Single mother Kelsey Leigh dies shielding Captain America from the Wrecking Crew, then returns from Avalon as the new Captain Britain and helps the Avengers defeat Morgan Le Fay.
102.8: When the Green Goblin murders Daily Bugle reporter Terri Kidder, Jessica Jones and Ben Urich expose Norman Osborn, who lands in prison after Spider-Man and Luke Cage beat him down.
102.9: Runaway teen Emma Frost falls for Troy in Boston, but after mobster Lucien kills him and holds her for ransom, she uses telepathic illusions to turn the gang on itself.
102.10: Bruce Banner hides with Nadia Dornova while a revived Betty Ross seeks his blood to cure her cancer, until the Hulk kills his monstrous Home Base clone and Banner leaves the cure behind.
102.12: Thanos visits the Kyln prison and leaves the mad Maker, a mortal Beyonder, in a coma, then defeats the Fallen One, Galactus' first herald, with Skreet's help and enslaves him.
102.13: Odin sends teenage Thor and his friends to gather four mystic elements, and Karnilla kills Thor with an arrow before he returns to life and Odin gives the forged sword to Balder.
102.14: Evicted from Avengers Mansion, She-Hulk joins a superhuman law firm as Jennifer Walters, where she puts a lying ghost on trial and stops shrunken villains riding out of the Big House on her skin.
102.15: Alex Wilder turns out to be the mole working for the Pride, and the Gibborim incinerate him after the ritual sacrifice the parents planned falls apart.
102.16: Jealous that Spider-Man has eclipsed his popularity, Johnny Storm seeks his advice, and their Hoboken water park fight with Hydro-Man leaves the Torch naked before a rescue wins back his fans.
102.17: Captain America distrusts Baron Zemo's plan to drain the world's dangerous energies, and the Avengers' assault lets Moonstone seize that power, leaving her catatonic while Zemo escapes with her gems.
102.18: Bishop and Officer Izzy Ortega police a Mutant Town drug war, then stop the reclusive Mr. M from leveling the district as Bishop absorbs his blast and an illusionist fakes the devastation.
102.19: Reed Richards solves the Tallus riddle on Earth-616, so Nocturne stays behind as Beak and Namora join the Exiles, who later redeem the Big M, an evil alternate Mimic.
102.20: Kitty Pryde finds a resurrected Colossus inside Benetech, where the alien Ord used his DNA to make Kavita Rao's mutant cure, and Wolverine forces Ord's escaping ship down.
102.21: Deadpool steals the Facade virus for the One World Church, and after it nearly melts him and Cable, a fix that mixes their DNA saves them before Cable briefly turns the world pink.
102.22: A letter from Gwen Stacy leads Peter to her adult twins, Sarah and Gabriel, whom Mary Jane reveals Norman Osborn fathered, and Gabriel attacks as the Grey Goblin until Sarah shoots down his glider.
102.23: Carnage spawns a symbiote that bonds with NYPD officer Pat Mulligan, and the new Toxin fends off a temporary alliance of Venom and Carnage.
102.24: Rachel Grey banishes the Fury after it ravages Braddock Manor and hijacks Sage, and the X-Men then survive Viper's Murderworld in London while Wolverine poses as Sage.
102.25: Havok leads a bickering X-Men squad to a collapsed Chinese village, where they free black hole mutant Shen Xorn from the Collective Man and Polaris recovers the helmet that contains his power.
102.26: Nightcrawler and Shadowcat disrupt Dr. Louis Childs' demonic ritual, leaving Pazuzu to kill Childs before Magik traps the demons, and Kurt later lays to rest the ghosts of subway workers killed in a buried accident.
102.27: The Hellions try to break Wither out of FBI custody after his powers kill his father, but David Alleyne leads the New Mutants to stop them, and a freed Wither joins the Hellions.
102.28: The Leader reveals himself as the mastermind behind Home Base and seizes control of the Hulk, and Nadia Blonsky dies in the battle before a grieving Bruce Banner flees.
102.30: Black Widow hides out with Matt Murdock when the U.S. government plans to trade her to Bulgaria for Madame Hydra, and the old partners fight off Jigsaw and a hired sniper.
102.31: Thor wins Sif's heart after Amora and Loki enchant him with a magic mirror, then lifts Mjolnir for the first time to rescue her from the Storm Giants and Hela.
102.32: After Spider-Man jails Norman Osborn, an unseen kidnapper who knows his identity takes Aunt May, and a battered Peter Parker chases false leads to Electro and the Vulture.
102.33: Mobster's son Angelo Fortunato buys the Venom symbiote at Eddie Brock's auction and attacks Peter Parker at his high school reunion, but the symbiote abandons him in midair and he falls to his death.
102.34: Scorpion reveals he took Aunt May for Norman Osborn, and after Spider-Man breaks the Goblin out of prison and battles the Sinister 12, he finds May buried alive in Uncle Ben's grave.
102.35: Wolverine tracks a District X killer to X-23, then the X-Men follow Sage into a reborn Hellfire Club, where Sebastian Shaw beheads Donald Pierce and Sunspot becomes Lord Imperial.
102.36: Pirates hired by Dark Beast strip the Genosha refugees of their powers with nanites, but Xavier outwits them, and Omega Sentinel Karima Shapandar breaks free to arrest Dark Beast.
102.37: The Scarlet Witch, unhinged by memories of her lost twins, unleashes attacks that kill Ant-Man and Hawkeye, and the Avengers disband after Doctor Strange subdues her and Magneto takes her away.
102.50: Galactus devours New Korbin after Korbinites turn Alpha Ray against Beta Ray Bill, who then teams with Stardust to slay the demon Asteroth and wakes on Earth in a dead veteran's body.
102.51: Bullseye stalls two federal agents hunting stolen plutonium with tales of his bloody past, then kills them in an escape that ends with the government paying him $3 million for its location.
102.52: Emma Frost defeats her telepathic mentor Astrid Bloom after learning Astrid orchestrated attacks on Emma's friends at Empire State University, but Ian Kendall rejects Emma once she reveals she is a mutant.
102.53: After a stint as a Magistrati judge battling the Champion, She-Hulk fakes her death to unsettle a Power Gem-wielding Titania and knocks her out with the stolen gem.
102.54: After a skiing accident ruins surgeon Stephen Strange's hands, Clea leads him to the Ancient One, and Strange embraces his destiny when Baron Mordo betrays their master to Dormammu.
102.55: Cable's floating Providence alarms the world until Nick Fury sends the Silver Surfer to defeat him, and Deadpool enlists the Fixer to revive his fallen partner.
102.56: Jamie Madrox tracks a stabbed dupe's killer to Chicago, where the dupe had married Sheila DeSoto, who becomes an insectoid monster before mobster Eddie Vance guns her down.
102.57: Rogue enters the Far Banks dream realm to stop spirits plaguing Caldecott, Mississippi, then absorbs her dream twin, Anna, and watches the lingering dream of her mother, Priscilla, vanish.
102.58: A new Brotherhood under Exodus kills young Sammy and storms the Xavier Institute until Xorn sucks the villains into the black hole in his head, taking Juggernaut and Nocturne along.
102.59: The ghost of Jeffrey Garrett, a student killed in Magneto's attack, haunts the Xavier Institute until the New Mutants reach him through a seance, and Kevin Ford later exposes Rahne Sinclair's fling with Josh Foley.
102.60: The Hand kills and brainwashes Wolverine for Hydra, and after his rampage kills Northstar, S.H.I.E.L.D. deprograms him to hunt the Gorgon, whose reflection in Wolverine's claws turns him to stone.
102.65: After the Exiles stop Ego from turning Earth into his offspring and survive Kulan Gath's spell over New York, the Great Beast Tanaraq seizes Heather Hudson until Shaman helps banish him, leaving her fully human.
102.66: Bishop and Izzy Ortega hunt the cannibal Winston Hobbes through the tunnels under Mutant Town, and Ortega guns him down before a government cover-up buries a teen mutant's deadly cafe standoff.
102.67: Mallen takes the stolen Extremis virus, and after Maya Hansen doses a beaten Tony Stark with it, the upgraded Iron Man kills Mallen and exposes Maya's role in the theft.
102.68: An assassin kills the Red Skull and delivers his Cosmic Cube to Aleksander Lukin, who sets Crossbones on Captain America, and a captured Sharon Carter swears her abductor was Bucky.
102.69: Freed after decades in prison, former crime boss Alexander Bont sends Gladiator after Matt Murdock, and new White Tiger Angela del Toro intervenes before Bont's Mutant Growth Hormone overdose kills him.
102.70: A Sisterhood of the Wasp thug stabs Brooklyn teen Anya Corazon as she shields mage Miguel Legar, whose ritual saves her with spider powers, and as Araña she crashes a Wasp ceremony in Queens.
102.71: Killers hunt the Red Room's old Black Widows to protect Gynacon's patents, and when Vassily Ulyanov breaks Natasha's nose and frees her from his control pheromone, she kills him and Ian McMasters.
102.72: The Shi'ar revive the Phoenix Force, which resurrects Jean Grey and briefly possesses Emma Frost, until the love of the X-Men helps Jean master it and depart for the White Hot Room.
102.73: Sarah Kinney clones Wolverine to create X-23, who destroys the Facility after years of abuse from Zander Rice, but Rice's trigger scent drives her to kill Sarah, who names her Laura as she dies.
102.74: Havok leads the X-Men to an Antarctic mutant colony the alien Golgotha has massacred, and its telepathy turns mutants violent until Polaris wipes out the incoming swarm with a magnetic pulse in space.
102.75: Spider-Man and Wolverine clash with Paul Patterson, a mutant student at Peter Parker's school, and Spider-Man teams with X-23 to stop an evil alternate Tony Stark from using the boy to open a portal home.
102.76: A photo of a forgotten Tokyo caper sends Rogue to Japan, where the memory thief Blindspot restores their shared past and Rogue battles Lady Deathstrike and the Silver Samurai alongside Sunfire.
102.77: Klaw, who killed T'Chaka years earlier, leads a mercenary army into Wakanda with U.S. backing, and T'Challa spears Klaw while Shuri kills Radioactive Man with the Ebony Blade.
102.78: Teenage Nathaniel Richards flees his destiny as Kang and assembles the Young Avengers as Iron Lad, then kills his future self and returns to his own time to repair history.
102.79: The Hauk'ka drag the X-Men into the Savage Land, where a deluded Rachel Grey harnesses Storm's powers for a global freeze until Psylocke and X-23 lead a rescue.
102.82: Hell's Kitchen residents trade stories about Daredevil at a church support group until Matt Murdock, newly married to Milla Donovan, tracks down a demonic creature summoned by a failed member of the Hand.
102.83: Punished for disobedience, the Exiles return to the Age of Apocalypse with Holocaust, who steals the M'Kraan Crystal and talks the team into using it to hunt the Timebroker.
102.84: Mystique poses as the runaway mutant Foxx to seduce Gambit and drive a wedge between him and Rogue, then asks to join the X-Men once she is unmasked.
102.85: The newly sentient Danger Room drives Wing to suicide and takes form as Danger to hunt Professor X in Genosha, where the X-Men learn he knowingly kept her enslaved.
102.86: Nightcrawler wakes from a coma and traces attacks on his old circuses to the demon Hive, then wields the Soulsword to free a possessed Wolverine and learns Hive also possessed his brother Stefan.
102.87: Captain America learns the Winter Soldier is a brainwashed Bucky Barnes working for Aleksander Lukin, then uses the Cosmic Cube to restore Bucky's memories before his horrified partner vanishes.
102.89: Hunted by the U.S. government, Natasha Romanova hides in Cuba with Yelena Belova, then falls captive while rescuing Sally Anne Carter from human traffickers until Yelena and Daredevil free her.
102.90: Nick Fury's secret strike on Latveria brings a revenge attack from cyborg Lucia von Bardas that puts Luke Cage in a coma, and Fury goes underground after Daisy Johnson destroys her.
102.92: Electro's mass breakout at the Raft unites a new Avengers team, which tracks the freed Karl Lykos to the Savage Land and uncovers a rogue S.H.I.E.L.D. unit mining vibranium with slave labor.
102.95: Peter Parker's bullied former classmate Charlie Weiderman fuses his skin with vibranium and seeks revenge as a new Molten Man, and Spider-Man freezes him solid as Aunt May's house burns.
102.96: After Tony Stark moves the Parkers into Avengers Tower, Spider-Man uncovers a Hydra plot to poison America's largest aquifer and rides the bioweapon rocket off course before it explodes.
